work.name: KU Leuven, Centre of Microbial and Plant Genetics (Computational Systems Biology group)
work.summary: Master's thesis: "Structural elucidation of phage-steered lysine acetylations in MetK".
highlights: Modelled putative enzymes with AlphaFold, followed by molecular dynamics simulations.
Introduced post-translational modifications in silico to approximate the hyperacetylation seen during phage infection, and analysed conformational impact (RMSF, RMSD, PCA).
Streamlined the molecular dynamics pipeline with Snakemake.
Communicated results in a ~90-page thesis and dissertation.

Quality assurance of the user interface.
